disabled.description: Disables summary activation. The page can still set open.

open.description: Whether the panel is open. Native changes reflect back to this property.

summary.description: Plain label for the control. Supply the summary slot for a rich label.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-details-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter for the backdrop behind the disclosure surface.

--ki-details-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the disclosure surface.

--ki-details-body-bg.description: Surface color of the disclosure body.

--ki-details-body-fg.description: Supporting text color of the disclosure body.

--ki-details-border.description: Color of the disclosure frame and accordion separators.

--ki-details-border-width.description: Width of the disclosure or accordion frame.

--ki-details-disabled-fg.description: Text and icon color of a disabled summary.

--ki-details-fg.description: Text color on the disclosure surface.

--ki-details-padding.description: Inline inset of the summary and inset of the panel body.

--ki-details-radius.description: Corners of a standalone disclosure or the accordion frame.

--ki-details-summary-hover-bg.description: Surface color of a hovered summary.

--ki-details-summary-hover-fg.description: Text and icon color of a hovered summary.

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-para.description: semantic dimension for typography line height para.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: A native disclosure for supporting information that can stay collapsed.

ki-toggle.description: Emitted for a native state change, including an exclusive peer closing.

disabled.description: Disables summary activation. The page can still set open.

open.description: Whether the panel is open. Native changes reflect back to this property.

summary.description: Plain label for the control. Supply the summary slot for a rich label.

slots.description: Content shown when the disclosure is open.

summary.description: Rich summary text or an authored heading, replacing the summary prop.
